item.text: I’ve got the current shape. The remaining improvement is to make the range-heap helper itself more readable by removing the extra plumbing parameters, and then I’ll trim some of the test helper boilerplate around exception checks.
I’m tightening the heap helper names and removing a few needless test accessor methods. That should leave the behavior untouched while making the code materially easier to scan.
I’m simplifying the test fixtures next: direct fields instead of getters, and a single assertion helper for thrown exceptions. That keeps the test harness compact and easier to extend.
The structural cleanup is in. I’m compiling from a clean slate now to catch any accidental access or syntax issues from the simplified test helpers and the renamed heap wrapper.
I’m trimming one more bit of test ceremony by folding the `sortedCopy(null)` null check into the main null-check block. That leaves the test harness smaller without dropping any coverage.

Refactored the codebase further to reduce internal plumbing and trim test ceremony.

What changed:
- Consolidated the range-sorting implementation into a private `RangeHeap` helper in [HeapSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSort.java#L60-L126), which keeps the range state together and removes extra base-index noise from the public API.
- Switched range validation to `Objects.checkFromToIndex(...)` in [HeapSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSort.java#L34-L43), which is clearer and standard-library backed.
- Simplified the test harness in [HeapSortTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSortTest.java#L5-L145) by:
  - removing getter boilerplate from the case holders
  - collapsing exception checks into one `assertThrows(...)`
  - keeping the table-driven cases, but with less indirection
- Kept the demo minimal and non-mutating via `sortedCopy(...)` in [HeapSortDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/036_heap_sort/HeapSortDemo.java#L9-L11)
